In Q2 2026, Tallink Grupp carried 1,454,725 passengers (-2.2% YoY), 68,986 cargo units (+2.9%), and 199,025 passenger vehicles (-6.5%). The segment reported a net loss of EUR 2.5 million (unchanged YoY), impacted by higher fuel costs (up EUR 8.4 million vs Q2 2025), full EU ETS emissions surrender (100% of CO2 equivalent vs 70% in 2025), and the 36-month charter of the Superfast IX vessel from May 2026.

The segment held a 29% market share in the Finnish-Baltic gas market. During Q2, Elenger continued developing battery energy storage systems, with a 4.5 MW facility in Liepāja, Latvia entering commercial operation at the start of Q3 2026. Polish subsidiaries secured a EUR 60 million loan agreement to expand the Polish gas business.
